sn56.44:1.2: “ahaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca sammā dukkhassantaṃ karissāmī’ti
sn56.44:2.2: “ahaṃ kūṭāgārassa heṭṭhimaṃ gharaṃ akaritvā uparimaṃ gharaṃ āropessāmī”ti
sn56.44:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, yo evaṃ vadeyya:
sn56.44:2.5: “ahaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca …pe… dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca sammā dukkhassantaṃ karissāmī”ti
sn56.44:3.1: yo ca kho bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya:
sn56.44:3.2: “ahaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamecca …pe… dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamecca sammā dukkhassantaṃ karissāmī”ti.
sn56.44:4.2: “ahaṃ kūṭāgārassa heṭṭhimaṃ gharaṃ, karitvā uparimaṃ gharaṃ āropessāmī”ti
sn56.44:4.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, yo evaṃ vadeyya:
sn56.44:4.5: “ahaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamecca …pe… dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamecca sammā dukkhassantaṃ karissāmīti
sn56.44:5.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkha”nti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
